IDENT.title: Cloud-based multi-agent architecture for effective planning and scheduling of distributed manufacturing

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No explicit definition; MAS characteristics stated as autonomy, reactive, proactive, social interaction (citing Moyaux and Chaib-draa; Swaminathan et al.)
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: MAS have certain characteristics like autonomy, reactive, proactive and social interaction

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: MAS have certain characteristics like autonomy, reactive, proactive and social interaction

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: a self-reactive cloud based multi agent architecture for distributed manufacturing system is developed

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: It consists of purchase order collection agent, supplier selection agent, planning agent, material planning agent, transport agent, administrative agent, forecasting agent

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: All the information and decision made with respect to manufacturing processes and procedures is being stored in Knowledge base agent.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: Algorithm portfolio is composed of various algorithms such as Genetic Algorithm (GA), Tabu Search (TS), Simulated Annealing (SA)

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: In this study, for precise and effective communication, agents will utilize MALLET communication channel.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Knowledge base agent also does the record keeping of the successful and unsuccessful decisions taken by all agents.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: KB agent stores all decisions, operation status, sequences, processing times, successful/unsuccessful decisions; transport agent records past transport; negotiation agent uses client past record.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: It is also aware of the sequence in which they were executed and the processing times associated with them.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: negotiation agent collects the information of existing order being processed from planning agent

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: It is accomplished by extracting information from all other agents and observing the tasks performed by them.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: It assists in preventing those mistakes to occur again.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: Purchase order collection agent keeps updating knowledge base agent throughout its activities.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: Knowledge base agent also does the record keeping of the successful and unsuccessful decisions taken by all agents.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: one agent collaborates with other agent via sending ‘help’ signals

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The interested clients will log in to the cloud using SaaS and participate in the bidding process.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: Agents lying in preceptor range of sender agent can only respond to this signal.

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: In the end, the control agent will allocate improved knowledge to all algorithm agents.

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: the selector will return frequently to its choice again and again.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: Execution process of proposed architecture is demonstrated using simulated case study.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: develop a new manufacturing plan to process orders of all the clients within their respective due dates of delivery

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: client C1 has contacted purchase order collection agent and request them that they need 45 more quantities of the same product

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: This framework comprises of eleven autonomous agents

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: This case study comprises of medium scale manufacturing company making various products.

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: converted and communicated via Extensible Markup Language (XML) for the purpose of unified interaction and communication across the cloud

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: planning agent will contact maintenance agent and will generate efficient reschedule manufacturing plan

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Functional/enterprise-level agents (purchase order, supplier selection, forecasting, administrative) rather than part/resource agents; central planning agent with metaheuristic algorithm portfolio; client bidding over cloud SaaS; MALLET/CAST communication.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: planning agent generates manufacturing plan using algorithm portfolio mechanism

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims coordination among units is mandatory; no component necessity claim for agents.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: coordination among the fragmented manufacturing units is mandatory to cope with the fluctuating demand of customers
